scenes.say: Brain freeze has nothing to do with your brain freezing.
It starts on the roof of your mouth.
scenes.heading: THE REAL SPOT

scenes.say: Something cold hits it. The blood vessels there squeeze tight, then suddenly widen again.
scenes.heading: WHAT HAPPENS

scenes.say: A nerve picks that up. But your brain can't tell where it's coming from, so you feel it in your forehead.
scenes.heading: THE MIX-UP

scenes.say: Doctors even have a name for it. Sphenopalatine ganglioneuralgia.
scenes.heading: OFFICIAL NAME

scenes.say: The fix? Press your tongue to the roof of your mouth to warm it up.
scenes.heading: THE FIX

scenes.say: Or just eat your ice cream slower.
Did you know brain freeze starts in your mouth?
